name: Glass-Thane
clergy: the Glass-Keepers, who tend the half-excavated mouths of the buried Concord cities and warn travelers against disturbing the glass
attitude_to_magic: The Glimmer is the force that turned the cities to glass; the Glass-Thane is the first to feel its return.

worship_by_species.name: Glass-Thane
worship_by_species.relation: feared as a omen of the Veil's return
worship_by_species.note: Crownlands septons warn that worshiping Glass-Thane is akin to courting the Quiet.

worship_by_species.name: the-Shattered-Anvil
worship_by_species.note: The deep-folk see him as the Anvil upon which the old world was broken; his glass is their metal's rival.

worship_by_species.name: rejected
worship_by_species.note: The greenfolk refuse to name him; they say the forest outlives the glass.

worship_by_species.name: the-Mirror-King
worship_by_species.note: In the desert, the glass that scours the dunes is his breath; oasis-worshipers leave polished shards as tribute.
